blocks.text: Quarterly revenue of KRW 195.3 trillion, operating profit at KRW 107.4 trillion
Samsung Electronics today reported financial results for the third quarter ended Sept. 30, 2026.

The Company posted KRW 195.3 trillion in consolidated revenue, another all-time quarterly high, representing a quarter-on-quarter (QoQ) increase of 14%. Operating profit reached KRW 107.4 trillion, making Samsung Electronics the world’s first tech company to exceed KRW 100 trillion in quarterly operating profit.

The Device Solutions (DS) Division posted a QoQ sales increase of 15%, with the Memory Business setting an all-time high for quarterly revenue and operating profit, as semiconductor demand is set to remain robust.
The Device eXperience (DX) Division posted a QoQ revenue increase of 8% and recorded an operating loss of KRW 0.8 trillion.
DS To Sustain Growth by Proactively Meeting Growing Demand for AI Applications
The DS Division posted KRW 147.1 trillion in consolidated revenue and KRW 106.5 trillion in operating profit for the third quarter.

The Memory Business achieved another record-breaking quarter by managing its product mix, with a focus on AI products, amid capacity constraints. Strong demand momentum for servers led to higher market prices across all applications.

Additionally, the Business experienced continued robust demand, driven by AI applications. It significantly scaled up sales of HBM4 on the back of industry-leading product competitiveness while proactively addressing growing demand for server SSDs.

In Q4 2026, the Memory Business expects industry-wide competition for AI leadership to drive continued AI infrastructure investment. Memory demand growth is projected to revolve around new CPU and GPU platform-related products, while surging QLC SSD demand will be linked to the expansion of personal AI agent services.

The Memory Business will also maintain a sales strategy focused on AI applications in order to solidify market leadership. Leveraging its industry-leading products and unmatched scale, the Business aims to achieve this by further increasing HBM, server DRAM, and SSD sales, while also increasing the supply of high-speed server DDR5 products and QLC SSDs.

In 2027, the Business expects AI infrastructure capital expenditure to reach a historic level as the AI ecosystem expands. Additionally, increasing AI-driven demand will far exceed the industry supply in comparison with 2026. The Business also aims to leverage its superior technology to bolster market leadership and optimize product mix in alignment with market trends and customer needs.

It plans to lead the high-end market and sharpen its AI-driven portfolio while building a stable sales base by securing multi-year contracts and ensuring timely readiness of new products tailored to the requirements of AI applications.

The System LSI Business achieved revenue growth in Q3 2026, driven by the mass production of systems-on-a-chip (SoCs) and image sensors for new models launched in H2. Additionally, the custom SoC business secured projects by establishing new customer partnerships.
In Q4 2026, the Business plans to maintain stable production and sales of flagship SoCs and 200MP image sensors.

In 2027, the System LSI Business aims to expand flagship SoC sales and strengthen partnerships with custom SoC customers. It also plans to accelerate sales of flagship high-resolution image sensors and diversify into non-mobile applications.

The Foundry Business experienced a notable revenue and earnings improvement on HBM base-die sales growth and expanded advanced-node sales, as well as continued order wins centered on 2nm HPC customers, including major hyperscalers.

Looking ahead to Q4 2026, the Foundry Business plans to achieve double-digit revenue growth and continued earnings improvement on new mobile products, mass production ramp-up of 4nm NPUs, and expanded memory product sales.

In 2027, the Business will aim for revenue growth led by 4nm and 2nm advanced nodes based on strong AI and HPC demand. It also expects to strengthen its global supply capabilities with the commencement of operations at its new fab in Taylor, Texas.
SDC To Build On Growth With Enhanced, Diversified Product Lineup
Samsung Display Corporation (SDC) posted KRW 8.0 trillion in consolidated revenue and KRW 1.1 trillion in operating profit for the third quarter.

For the small and medium display business, SDC reported improved earnings based on solid demand for high-end mobile products, while the large display business expanded sales volume and revenue on the growth of the gaming monitor market.
In Q4 2026, SDC expects a positive effect from year-end peak seasonal demand and new product launches, but it anticipates a limited improvement in earnings due to external factors.

During the quarter, the small and medium display business will pursue sales expansion by actively responding to customer demand, while the large display business will focus on improving profitability centered on gaming monitors.

In 2027, SDC expects continued market demand weakness amid ongoing uncertainty. For smartphones, the small and medium display business aims to increase the portion of premium products like foldables, and for IT, the business will pursue sales expansion through the ramp-up of the new 8.6G IT line and strengthening of the product lineup. The large display business aims to continue pursuing improved profitability centered on high value-added models.
MX To Maintain Mobile Leadership by Capitalizing on the High-Growth Premium Market

The MX and Networks Businesses posted a combined KRW 37.7 trillion in consolidated revenue and reported an operating loss of KRW 0.6 trillion for the third quarter. Revenue increased QoQ and year-on-year (YoY), mainly driven by new flagship launches including foldables. Earnings increased QoQ with an improved flagship sales mix, but declined YoY due to cost pressures.

In Q4 2026, the MX Business plans to drive year-end peak-season sales growth centered on flagships including the Galaxy S26 series, Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra, and Z Fold8, as well as new ecosystem products. It will also seek to mitigate profitability risks through efficiency improvements across all business processes.

In 2027, the MX Business aims to maintain its mobile leadership by focusing on three strategic priorities. First, it will improve its product mix, centered on flagships with differentiated experiences by customer segment. Second, it will enhance the desirability and deliver tangible value of products through hardware and form-factor innovation. Third, it will minimize declines in profit with agile market responses and operational efficiency initiatives.

In Q3 2026, the Networks Business saw a decline in earnings QoQ and YoY due to lower North American and high-margin software sales. In Q4 2026, the Business aims to secure profitability through revenue growth in North America, Korea, and Japan. In 2027, the Business plans to drive profitable growth by securing new orders amid telco investment headwinds.
VD/DA Businesses and Harman To Extend AI-Based Product Innovation
The Visual Display (VD) and Digital Appliances (DA) Businesses posted a combined KRW 13.9 trillion in consolidated revenue and reported an operating loss of KRW 0.2 trillion for the third quarter.

The VD Business saw revenue decline due to the conclusion of major sporting events, while earnings decreased due to increased costs. In Q4 2026, the Business aims to capture peak season demand through strengthened channel partnerships and differentiated marketing, while expanding sales of premium products in order to offset the impact of rising costs. In 2027, while overall TV demand is expected to remain flat or decline slightly, the Business will focus on securing profitable growth engines by delivering differentiated TV experiences, as well as strengthening the service and platform businesses.

Meanwhile, the DA Business’ earnings declined due to higher costs related to raw materials and logistics, despite stronger domestic marketing efforts and growth in the B2B and subscription businesses. In Q4 2026, the Business intends to improve profitability with a higher premium mix, and in 2027, it aims to secure profitability by expanding sales of innovative AI products and growing its high-margin B2B businesses.

Harman posted improved earnings on expanded audio and automotive sales, with a boost from non-recurring U.S. tariff refunds. Looking ahead, the Business will seek to maintain stable growth momentum by developing new automotive business and extending audio leadership through portfolio enhancements.
Shareholder Return: Q3 Dividend Details and Total Payout
The third-quarter cash dividend amounts to KRW 4,601 per common share and KRW 4,601 per preferred share, totaling KRW 30 trillion.

Of the estimated KRW 90~110 trillion in total shareholder returns for 2026, and with KRW 35 trillion already planned or completed, the company anticipates the remaining funds to be KRW 55~75 trillion.
The return of the remaining funds will include a substantial share repurchase and cancellation program, along with cash dividends.

The Company recognizes the growing market interest in the price gap between common and preferred shares, and is committed to actively considering and adjusting the proportion of preferred shares in our share repurchase and cancellation program based on market conditions.

The next shareholder return policy, along with the final amount of shareholder returns and the specific execution plans for the remaining funds for 2026, will be finalized at the Board meeting scheduled for late January 2027, with an announcement to follow.
Third Quarter 2026 Capital Expenditures

In the third quarter, Samsung Electronics’ capital expenditure reached KRW 29 trillion, an increase of KRW 12.2 trillion quarter-on-quarter (QoQ) and KRW 19.8 trillion year-on-year (YoY). Capital expenditure consisted of KRW 27.2 trillion spent in the Device Solutions (DS) Division and KRW 1.1 trillion in Samsung Display Corporation (SDC). The cumulative total for the January-September period is KRW 56.9 trillion, up KRW 24.7 trillion YoY, with KRW 52.8 trillion allocated to the DS Division and KRW 2.4 trillion to SDC.
The full-year capital expenditure for 2026 is expected at approximately KRW 84.4 trillion, including KRW 76.8 trillion allocated to the DS Division and KRW 3.9 trillion to SDC.

For the DS Division, investments are planned for new fabs and other infrastructure to meet strong AI and HPC demand while ensuring readiness for the mid-to long term. For SDC, investments will focus on upgrades to existing production lines.

blocks.text: 季度营收为KRW 195.3 trillion，营业利润为KRW 107.4 trillion
三星电子今日公布了截至2026年9月30日的第三季度财务业绩。
公司公布合并营收为KRW 195.3 trillion，再次创下季度历史新高，环比（QoQ）增长14%。营业利润达到KRW 107.4 trillion，使三星电子成为全球首家季度营业利润超过KRW 100 trillion的科技公司。
设备解决方案（DS）部门销售额环比增长15%，其中存储业务创下季度营收和营业利润历史新高，因半导体需求预计将保持强劲。
设备体验（DX）部门营收环比增长8%，录得营业亏损KRW 0.8 trillion。
DS将通过积极满足AI应用日益增长的需求来维持增长
DS部门第三季度合并营收为KRW 147.1 trillion，营业利润为KRW 106.5 trillion。
存储业务在产能受限的情况下，通过管理产品组合、聚焦AI产品，再次实现创纪录季度。服务器需求势头强劲，推动所有应用市场价格上涨。
此外，受AI应用驱动，该业务持续经历强劲需求。依托行业领先的产品竞争力，该业务大幅提升了HBM4销量，同时积极满足不断增长的服务器SSD需求。
2026年第四季度，存储业务预计，全行业对AI领导地位的竞争将推动AI基础设施投资持续增长。存储需求增长预计将围绕新的CPU和GPU平台相关产品展开，而QLC SSD需求的激增将与个人AI代理服务的扩张相关联。
存储业务还将维持聚焦AI应用的销售策略，以巩固市场领导地位。借助行业领先的产品和无与伦比的规模，该业务旨在通过进一步增加HBM、服务器DRAM和SSD销量，同时增加高速服务器DDR5产品和QLC SSD的供应来实现这一目标。
2027年，随着AI生态系统扩张，该业务预计AI基础设施资本支出将达到历史水平。此外，与2026年相比，AI驱动的需求增长将远超行业供应。该业务还旨在利用其先进技术来巩固市场领导地位，并根据市场趋势和客户需求优化产品组合。
该业务计划引领高端市场并强化其AI驱动产品组合，同时通过确保多年期合同以及确保针对AI应用需求的新产品及时就绪，来建立稳定的销售基础。
系统LSI业务在2026年第三季度实现营收增长，主要受下半年发布的新机型所用系统级芯片（SoC）和图像传感器量产推动。此外，定制SoC业务通过建立新的客户合作关系获得了项目。
2026年第四季度，该业务计划维持旗舰SoC和200MP图像传感器的稳定生产和销售。
2027年，系统LSI业务旨在扩大旗舰SoC销量，并加强与定制SoC客户的合作关系。该业务还计划加速旗舰高分辨率图像传感器的销售，并向非移动应用领域多元化拓展。
晶圆代工业务因HBM基础裸片销售增长、先进节点销售扩大，以及以2nm HPC客户（包括主要超大规模云服务商）为中心的持续订单获取，营收和盈利显著改善。
展望2026年第四季度，晶圆代工业务计划依托新移动产品、4nm NPU量产爬坡以及存储产品销量扩大，实现两位数营收增长和盈利持续改善。
2027年，该业务将力争在强劲AI和HPC需求推动下，实现由4nm和2nm先进节点引领的营收增长。该公司还预计，随着其在得克萨斯州泰勒市的新晶圆厂开始运营，将增强其全球供应能力。
SDC将通过增强且多元化的产品阵容延续增长
三星显示公司（SDC）第三季度合并营收为KRW 8.0 trillion，营业利润为KRW 1.1 trillion。
在中小尺寸显示业务方面，SDC公布，基于高端移动产品的稳健需求，盈利有所改善；而大尺寸显示业务则随着游戏显示器市场的增长，扩大了销量和营收。
SDC预计，Q4 2026将受益于年末旺季需求和新品发布，但受外部因素影响，盈利改善预计有限。
本季度，中小尺寸显示业务将通过积极响应客户需求来推动销售扩张，而大尺寸显示业务将专注于以游戏显示器为中心提升盈利能力。
2027年，SDC预计，在持续不确定性下市场需求仍将疲软。对于智能手机，中小尺寸显示业务旨在提高可折叠产品等高端产品的占比；对于IT，该业务将通过新8.6G IT产线爬坡和强化产品阵容来推动销售扩张。大尺寸显示业务旨在继续以高附加值机型为中心提升盈利能力。
MX将借助高增长高端市场保持移动领导地位
MX与网络业务第三季度合并营收为KRW 37.7 trillion，并报告营业亏损KRW 0.6 trillion。营收环比和同比均增长，主要受包括可折叠产品在内的新旗舰产品发布推动。盈利因旗舰产品销售结构改善而环比增长，但受成本压力影响同比下降。
在Q4 2026，MX业务计划围绕包括Galaxy S26系列、Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra和Z Fold8在内的旗舰产品以及新生态系统产品，推动年末旺季销售增长。该业务还将通过全业务流程效率提升来缓解盈利风险。
2027年，MX业务旨在通过聚焦三大战略重点来保持其移动领导地位。第一，将改善产品结构，重点围绕按客户细分提供差异化体验的旗舰产品。第二，将通过硬件和形态创新提升产品吸引力并交付切实价值。第三，将通过敏捷市场应对和运营效率举措尽量减少利润下滑。
在Q3 2026，网络业务因北美和高毛利软件销售下降，盈利环比和同比下降。在Q4 2026，该业务旨在通过北美、韩国和日本营收增长确保盈利能力。2027年，该业务计划在电信投资逆风下通过获取新订单推动盈利增长。
VD/DA业务与Harman将拓展基于AI的产品创新
视觉显示（VD）与数字家电（DA）业务第三季度合并营收为KRW 13.9 trillion，并报告营业亏损KRW 0.2 trillion。
VD业务因重大体育赛事结束而营收下降，同时成本增加导致盈利下降。在Q4 2026，该业务旨在通过强化渠道合作和差异化营销把握旺季需求，同时扩大高端产品销售以抵消成本上升的影响。2027年，尽管整体电视需求预计持平或小幅下降，该业务将专注于通过提供差异化电视体验以及强化服务与平台业务来确保盈利增长引擎。
与此同时，DA业务尽管国内营销力度加大且B2B和订阅业务增长，但因原材料和物流相关成本上升，盈利下降。在Q4 2026，该业务打算通过提高高端产品结构来改善盈利能力；2027年，旨在通过扩大创新AI产品销售和增长高毛利B2B业务来确保盈利能力。
Harman因音频和汽车销售扩大而盈利改善，并受益于美国一次性关税退款。展望未来，该业务将通过开发新汽车业务和通过产品组合优化延伸音频领导地位，寻求保持稳定增长势头。
股东回报：第三季度股息详情与总派息
第三季度现金股息为每股普通股KRW 4,601、每股优先股KRW 4,601，总计KRW 30 trillion。
在2026年预计总额为KRW 90~110 trillion的股东回报中，已有KRW 35 trillion被计划或完成，公司预计剩余资金为KRW 55~75 trillion。
剩余资金的返还将包括大规模股份回购与注销计划，以及现金分红。
公司认识到市场对普通股与优先股之间价差的兴趣日益增长，并致力于根据市场状况积极考虑和调整我们股份回购与注销计划中优先股的比例。
下一项股东回报政策，以及2026年剩余资金的最终股东回报金额和具体执行计划，将在定于2027年1月下旬举行的董事会会议上最终确定，随后将发布公告。
2026年第三季度资本支出

第三季度，Samsung Electronics的资本支出达到KRW 29 trillion，环比（QoQ）增加KRW 12.2 trillion，同比（YoY）增加KRW 19.8 trillion。资本支出包括在设备解决方案（DS）事业部支出的KRW 27.2 trillion，以及在Samsung Display Corporation（SDC）支出的KRW 1.1 trillion。1月至9月累计总额为KRW 56.9 trillion，同比增加KRW 24.7 trillion，其中KRW 52.8 trillion分配给DS事业部，KRW 2.4 trillion分配给SDC。
2026年全年资本支出预计约为KRW 84.4 trillion，其中KRW 76.8 trillion分配给DS事业部，KRW 3.9 trillion分配给SDC。
对于DS事业部，计划投资于新晶圆厂和其他基础设施，以满足强劲的AI和HPC需求，同时确保中长期准备就绪。对于SDC，投资将聚焦于现有生产线的升级。

此外，受AI应用驱动，该业务持续经历强劲需求。依托行业领先的产品竞争力，该业务大幅提升了HBM4销量，同时积极满足不断增长的服务器SSD需求。

存储业务还将维持聚焦AI应用的销售策略，以巩固市场领导地位。借助行业领先的产品和无与伦比的规模，该业务旨在通过进一步增加HBM、服务器DRAM和SSD销量，同时增加高速服务器DDR5产品和QLC SSD的供应来实现这一目标。

2027年，随着AI生态系统扩张，该业务预计AI基础设施资本支出将达到历史水平。此外，与2026年相比，AI驱动的需求增长将远超行业供应。该业务还旨在利用其先进技术来巩固市场领导地位，并根据市场趋势和客户需求优化产品组合。

该业务计划引领高端市场并强化其AI驱动产品组合，同时通过确保多年期合同以及确保针对AI应用需求的新产品及时就绪，来建立稳定的销售基础。

系统LSI业务在2026年第三季度实现营收增长，主要受下半年发布的新机型所用系统级芯片（SoC）和图像传感器量产推动。此外，定制SoC业务通过建立新的客户合作关系获得了项目。

2026年第四季度，该业务计划维持旗舰SoC和200MP图像传感器的稳定生产和销售。

2027年，系统LSI业务旨在扩大旗舰SoC销量，并加强与定制SoC客户的合作关系。该业务还计划加速旗舰高分辨率图像传感器的销售，并向非移动应用领域多元化拓展。

晶圆代工业务因HBM基础裸片销售增长、先进节点销售扩大，以及以2nm HPC客户（包括主要超大规模云服务商）为中心的持续订单获取，营收和盈利显著改善。

展望2026年第四季度，晶圆代工业务计划依托新移动产品、4nm NPU量产爬坡以及存储产品销量扩大，实现两位数营收增长和盈利持续改善。

2027年，该业务将力争在强劲AI和HPC需求推动下，实现由4nm和2nm先进节点引领的营收增长。该公司还预计，随着其在得克萨斯州泰勒市的新晶圆厂开始运营，将增强其全球供应能力。

SDC将通过增强且多元化的产品阵容延续增长

三星显示公司（SDC）第三季度合并营收为KRW 8.0 trillion，营业利润为KRW 1.1 trillion。

在中小尺寸显示业务方面，SDC公布，基于高端移动产品的稳健需求，盈利有所改善；而大尺寸显示业务则随着游戏显示器市场的增长，扩大了销量和营收。

SDC预计，Q4 2026将受益于年末旺季需求和新品发布，但受外部因素影响，盈利改善预计有限。

本季度，中小尺寸显示业务将通过积极响应客户需求来推动销售扩张，而大尺寸显示业务将专注于以游戏显示器为中心提升盈利能力。

2027年，SDC预计，在持续不确定性下市场需求仍将疲软。对于智能手机，中小尺寸显示业务旨在提高可折叠产品等高端产品的占比；对于IT，该业务将通过新8.6G IT产线爬坡和强化产品阵容来推动销售扩张。大尺寸显示业务旨在继续以高附加值机型为中心提升盈利能力。

MX将借助高增长高端市场保持移动领导地位

MX与网络业务第三季度合并营收为KRW 37.7 trillion，并报告营业亏损KRW 0.6 trillion。营收环比和同比均增长，主要受包括可折叠产品在内的新旗舰产品发布推动。盈利因旗舰产品销售结构改善而环比增长，但受成本压力影响同比下降。

在Q4 2026，MX业务计划围绕包括Galaxy S26系列、Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra和Z Fold8在内的旗舰产品以及新生态系统产品，推动年末旺季销售增长。该业务还将通过全业务流程效率提升来缓解盈利风险。

2027年，MX业务旨在通过聚焦三大战略重点来保持其移动领导地位。第一，将改善产品结构，重点围绕按客户细分提供差异化体验的旗舰产品。第二，将通过硬件和形态创新提升产品吸引力并交付切实价值。第三，将通过敏捷市场应对和运营效率举措尽量减少利润下滑。

在Q3 2026，网络业务因北美和高毛利软件销售下降，盈利环比和同比下降。在Q4 2026，该业务旨在通过北美、韩国和日本营收增长确保盈利能力。2027年，该业务计划在电信投资逆风下通过获取新订单推动盈利增长。

VD/DA业务与Harman将拓展基于AI的产品创新

视觉显示（VD）与数字家电（DA）业务第三季度合并营收为KRW 13.9 trillion，并报告营业亏损KRW 0.2 trillion。

VD业务因重大体育赛事结束而营收下降，同时成本增加导致盈利下降。在Q4 2026，该业务旨在通过强化渠道合作和差异化营销把握旺季需求，同时扩大高端产品销售以抵消成本上升的影响。2027年，尽管整体电视需求预计持平或小幅下降，该业务将专注于通过提供差异化电视体验以及强化服务与平台业务来确保盈利增长引擎。

与此同时，DA业务尽管国内营销力度加大且B2B和订阅业务增长，但因原材料和物流相关成本上升，盈利下降。在Q4 2026，该业务打算通过提高高端产品结构来改善盈利能力；2027年，旨在通过扩大创新AI产品销售和增长高毛利B2B业务来确保盈利能力。

Harman因音频和汽车销售扩大而盈利改善，并受益于美国一次性关税退款。展望未来，该业务将通过开发新汽车业务和通过产品组合优化延伸音频领导地位，寻求保持稳定增长势头。

股东回报：第三季度股息详情与总派息

第三季度现金股息为每股普通股KRW 4,601、每股优先股KRW 4,601，总计KRW 30 trillion。

在2026年预计总额为KRW 90~110 trillion的股东回报中，已有KRW 35 trillion被计划或完成，公司预计剩余资金为KRW 55~75 trillion。

剩余资金的返还将包括大规模股份回购与注销计划，以及现金分红。

公司认识到市场对普通股与优先股之间价差的兴趣日益增长，并致力于根据市场状况积极考虑和调整我们股份回购与注销计划中优先股的比例。

下一项股东回报政策，以及2026年剩余资金的最终股东回报金额和具体执行计划，将在定于2027年1月下旬举行的董事会会议上最终确定，随后将发布公告。

2026年第三季度资本支出

第三季度，Samsung Electronics的资本支出达到KRW 29 trillion，环比（QoQ）增加KRW 12.2 trillion，同比（YoY）增加KRW 19.8 trillion。资本支出包括在设备解决方案（DS）事业部支出的KRW 27.2 trillion，以及在Samsung Display Corporation（SDC）支出的KRW 1.1 trillion。1月至9月累计总额为KRW 56.9 trillion，同比增加KRW 24.7 trillion，其中KRW 52.8 trillion分配给DS事业部，KRW 2.4 trillion分配给SDC。

2026年全年资本支出预计约为KRW 84.4 trillion，其中KRW 76.8 trillion分配给DS事业部，KRW 3.9 trillion分配给SDC。

对于DS事业部，计划投资于新晶圆厂和其他基础设施，以满足强劲的AI和HPC需求，同时确保中长期准备就绪。对于SDC，投资将聚焦于现有生产线的升级。

items.title: KLA Corporation Reports Fiscal 2027 First Quarter Results
items.summary: KLA公布2027财年第一季度业绩，营收$4.14 billion，高于指引区间中点；公司称过程控制对AI生态建设仍关键，并给出第二季度营收$4.7 billion +/- $200 million的指引。
items.reason: 公司官方财报披露季度营收、盈利、现金流及下季指引，并给出过程控制需求定性判断；属常规季报，未披露具体新产品或客户订单，行动性有限。；存在待复核项

evidence.quote: Process control, and KLA in particular, continues to be critical to the AI ecosy

items: Total revenues were $4.14 billion, above the midpoint of the guidance range of $4.0 billion +/- $200 million;
GAAP diluted EPS was $1.18 and non-GAAP diluted EPS was $1.22, both above the midpoints of the respective guidance ranges;

Cash flow from operating activities for the quarter and last twelve months were $1.53 billion and $4.51 billion, respectively, and free cash flow was $1.34 billion and $4.04 billion, respectively; and
Capital returns for the quarter and last twelve months were $1.24 billion and $3.79 billion, respectively.

blocks.text: "KLA's September quarter beat the midpoint of guidance across all key metrics, demonstrating the accelerated growth we expected for the second half of calendar 2026," said Rick Wallace, president and CEO of KLA Corporation. "Process control, and KLA in particular, continues to be critical to the AI ecosystem buildout and benefits from numerous ongoing inflections, including increases in leading-edge designs across foundry and logic, device size and value, memory complexity and performance requirements, and the importance of advanced packaging. In addition, KLA's process, PCB, and component inspection businesses are benefiting from the technology transitions and the rigorous performance requirements of high-performance computing, which further augments the company's growth profile. KLA's market-leading product portfolio and its associated services offerings remain well positioned to address these compelling opportunities as we approach the end of calendar 2026 and look forward to calendar 2027."

About KLA:

KLA Corporation ("KLA") develops industry-leading equipment and services that enable innovation throughout the electronics industry. We provide advanced process control and process-enabling solutions for manufacturing wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging and printed circuit boards. In close collaboration with leading customers across the globe, our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers design solutions that move the world forward. Investors and others should note that KLA announces material financial information including SEC filings, press releases, public earnings calls and conference webcasts using an investor relations website (ir.kla.com). Additional information may be found at: www.kla.com.

blocks.text: The non-GAAP and supplemental information provided in this press release is a supplement to, and not a substitute for, KLA's financial results presented in accordance with United States GAAP.

To supplement our Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements presented in accordance with GAAP, we provide certain non-GAAP financial information, which is adjusted from results based on GAAP to exclude certain gains, costs and expenses, as well as other supplemental information. The non-GAAP and supplemental information is provided to enhance the user's overall understanding of our operating performance and our prospects in the future. Specifically, we believe that the non-GAAP information, including non-GAAP net income, non-GAAP net income per diluted share, non-GAAP gross margin and free cash flow, provides useful measures to both management and investors regarding financial and business trends relating to our financial performance by excluding certain costs and expenses that we believe are not indicative of our core operating results to help investors compare our operating performances with our results in prior periods as well as with the performance of other companies. The non-GAAP information is among the budgeting and planning tools that management uses for future forecasting. However, because there are no standardized or generally accepted definitions for most non-GAAP financial metrics, definitions of non-GAAP financial metrics are inherently subject to significant discretion (for example, determining which costs and expenses to exclude when calculating such a metric). As a result, non-GAAP financial metrics may be defined very differently from company to company, or even from period to period within the same company, which can potentially limit the usefulness of such information to an investor. The presentation of non-GAAP and supplemental information is not meant to be considered in isolation or as a substitute for results prepared and presented in accordance with United States GAAP. The following are descriptions of the adjustments made to reconcile GAAP net income to non-GAAP net income:

rows: Acquisition-related charges primarily include amortization of intangible assets. Acquisition-related charges during the three months ended June 30, 2026 also include a discrete release of $11.6 million of interest on unrecognized tax positions recorded as part of purchase price accounting arising from acquisitions. Although we exclude the effect of amortization of all acquired intangible assets from these non-GAAP financial measures, management believes that it is important for investors to understand that such intangible assets were recorded as part of purchase price accounting arising from acquisitions, and such amortization of intangible assets related to past acquisitions will recur in future periods until such intangible assets have been fully amortized. Investors should note that the use of these intangible assets contributed to our revenues earned during the periods presented and are expected to contribute to our future period revenues as well.
Income tax effect of non-GAAP adjustments includes the income tax effects of the excluded items noted above.

Pillar Two undertaxed profits rule taxes represents the impact of Undertaxed Profits Rule taxes arising from Pillar Two legislation. We expect these taxes to be temporary and reverse upon adoption of the Side-by-Side Safe Harbor provisions, which would exempt U.S.-parented groups from the Undertaxed Profits Rule.

Discrete tax items in the three months ended Sept. 30, 2025 include the recognition of a deferred tax liability for withholding taxes on future remittance of previously taxed income as a result of new tax legislation. Discrete tax items in all periods presented include a tax impact relating to the amortization of tax benefits from internal restructuring or similar tax benefits recorded in other periods.

blocks.text: KLA Corporation总裁兼首席执行官Rick Wallace表示：“KLA的9月季度在所有关键指标上均超过指引中点，表明我们此前预计在2026日历年下半年实现的加速增长。制程控制，尤其是KLA的制程控制，对AI生态系统建设仍然至关重要，并受益于众多持续发生的拐点，包括晶圆代工和逻辑领域先进设计增加、器件尺寸和价值提升、存储器复杂度和性能要求提高，以及先进封装重要性上升。此外，KLA的制程、PCB和组件检测业务正受益于技术转型以及高性能计算的严苛性能要求，这进一步增强了公司的增长态势。在我们临近2026日历年年末并展望2027日历年之际，KLA市场领先的产品组合及其相关服务产品仍处于有利位置来把握这些极具吸引力的机遇。”

KLA Corporation（“KLA”）开发行业领先的设备和服务，助力整个电子行业的创新。我们为晶圆和掩模版、集成电路、封装和印刷电路板的制造提供先进的制程控制和工艺赋能解决方案。我们由物理学家、工程师、数据科学家和问题解决专家组成的专业团队与全球领先客户紧密合作，设计推动世界前行的解决方案。投资者及其他人士应注意，KLA通过投资者关系网站（ir.kla.com）公布重大财务信息，包括SEC文件、新闻稿、公开财报电话会议和会议网播。更多信息请访问：www.kla.com。
关于前瞻性陈述的说明：

本新闻稿中除历史事实外的陈述，例如涉及股息金额和时间、股票回购金额和时间、截至2026年12月31日止季度的总收入、GAAP和非GAAP毛利率以及GAAP和非GAAP稀释每股收益的陈述，均属前瞻性陈述，并受1995年《私人证券诉讼改革法案》所创建的安全港条款约束。这些前瞻性陈述基于当前信息和预期，并涉及若干风险和不确定性。由于各种因素，实际结果可能与此类陈述中预测的结果存在重大差异，这些因素包括但不限于：我们易受金融市场和全球经济状况走弱的影响；与我们国际运营相关的风险；美国商务部工业与安全局不断演变的规则和法规及其对我们向中国某些客户销售产品和提供服务的能力的影响；关税、报复性贸易措施和其他贸易限制，以及关税权限、实施和退款流程方面的不确定性；代价高昂的知识产权纠纷，可能导致我们无法销售或使用受到质疑的技术；与我们开展业务所在的法律、监管和税务环境相关的风险；利益相关者对环境、社会及治理（“ESG”）事项的不同期望、要求和关注，以及由此产生的成本、风险和对我们业务的影响；在实现我们的环境、气候或其他ESG目标、目的和承诺，或满足利益相关者期望方面出现意外延迟、困难和费用；我们吸引、留住和激励关键人员的能力；我们易受第三方服务提供商中断和延迟的影响；网络安全威胁、影响我们及业务合作伙伴系统和网络的网络事件；我们对关键信息的依赖，包括日常运营所依赖的企业资源规划系统；与收购、整合、战略联盟或合作安排相关的风险；气候变化、自然灾害、公共卫生危机、恐怖主义、战争行为和其他灾难性事件及其对我们业务运营的不利影响；乌克兰与俄罗斯之间的战争、伊朗和中东其他地区的武装冲突，以及这些地区的重大军事活动；对恐怖分子和战争行为造成的损失和中断缺乏保险，以及我们对包括地震风险在内的某些风险进行自保；与外币汇率波动相关的风险；与利率及我们投资组合市值波动相关的风险；与我们利率对冲活动相关的风险；与税务和监管合规审计相关的风险；税收规则或实践的任何变化以及我们的实际税率；遵守联邦证券法律、规则、法规、NASDAQ要求以及不断演变的会计准则和实践所产生的合规成本；技术行业持续变化，包括人工智能（“AI”）相关发展以及半导体制造工艺、客户投资模式和终端市场需求的变化；我们易受客户基础高度集中的影响；我们所在行业的周期性；我们及时开发能够成功应对行业变化的新技术和新产品的能力；与我们、竞争对手和第三方开发、采用、治理和使用AI相关的风险；我们维持技术优势和保护专有权利的能力；我们在行业中竞争的能力；我们产品生产中使用的组件、材料或子组件的可用性和成本，包括由于供应来源有限的供应商、稀土元素可用性或DRAM芯片短缺所导致的情况；我们按照业务计划经营业务的能力；与我们的债务和杠杆资本结构相关的风险；我们可能完全无法宣布现金股息，或无法按任何特定金额宣布现金股息；如果我们的产品未能正常运行或存在缺陷，或我们的客户因我们的产品而被第三方起诉，我们根据赔偿条款对客户承担的责任；与获得政府资金相关的风险；我们可能产生重大重组费用或其他资产减值费用或存货核销；我们面临与应收账款保理、银行安排以及与政府的某些和解协议的合规风险相关的风险；以及与特拉华州衡平法院成为某些诉讼和程序唯一且排他性管辖法院相关的风险。有关可能导致实际结果与本新闻稿中前瞻性陈述所预测和预期结果存在重大差异的其他因素，请参阅KLA截至2026年6月30日止年度的Form 10-K年度报告，以及其后向美国证券交易委员会提交的其他文件（包括但不限于其中描述的风险因素）。KLA不承担更新这些前瞻性陈述的义务，且目前无意更新。

blocks.text: 本新闻稿中提供的非GAAP及补充信息是对KLA按照美国GAAP列示的财务业绩的补充，而不是替代。

为了补充我们按照GAAP列示的简明合并财务报表，我们提供某些非GAAP财务信息以及其他补充信息；这些非GAAP财务信息基于GAAP业绩进行调整，以剔除某些收益、成本和费用。提供非GAAP及补充信息是为了增强用户对我们经营业绩和未来前景的整体理解。具体而言，我们认为，非GAAP信息（包括非GAAP净利润、非GAAP摊薄每股净利润、非GAAP毛利率和自由现金流）为管理层和投资者提供了有用的衡量指标，有助于了解与我们的财务业绩相关的财务和业务趋势，因为这些指标剔除了某些我们认为不能反映我们核心经营业绩的成本和费用，从而帮助投资者将我们的经营业绩与前期业绩以及其他公司的业绩进行比较。非GAAP信息是管理层用于未来预测的预算和规划工具之一。然而，由于大多数非GAAP财务指标没有标准化或普遍接受的统一定义，非GAAP财务指标的定义本质上具有很大的自主裁量空间（例如，在计算该指标时确定应剔除哪些成本和费用）。因此，不同公司之间，甚至同一公司的不同期间，非GAAP财务指标的定义可能差异很大，这可能会限制此类信息对投资者的有用性。非GAAP及补充信息的列示不应被孤立地考虑，也不应替代按照美国GAAP编制和列示的业绩。以下是将GAAP净利润调节为非GAAP净利润所作调整的说明：

rows: 收购相关费用主要包括无形资产摊销。截至2026年6月30日的三个月，收购相关费用还包括一次性释放的1160万美元利息，该利息涉及作为收购产生的购买价格会计处理的一部分而记录的未确认税务状况。尽管我们在这些非GAAP财务指标中排除了所有收购所得无形资产摊销的影响，但管理层认为，投资者必须理解，此类无形资产是作为收购产生的购买价格会计处理的一部分记录的，且与过往收购相关的此类无形资产摊销将在未来期间重复发生，直至此类无形资产全部摊销完毕。投资者应注意，这些无形资产的使用对我们列报期间已赚取收入有所贡献，并预计也将对我们未来期间收入有所贡献。
非GAAP调整的所得税影响包括上述剔除项目的所得税影响。
支柱二低税利润规则税款代表由支柱二立法产生的低税利润规则税款的影响。我们预计这些税款将是暂时性的，并将在采用并行安全港条款后转回，该条款将使美国母公司集团免于适用低税利润规则。
截至 Sept. 30, 2025 的三个月内的离散税项包括：因新税法而就此前已征税收入未来汇回所涉及的预提税确认了一项递延所得税负债。所列示各期间的离散税项均包括与内部重组产生的税收优惠摊销相关的税务影响，或其他期间记录的类似税收优惠。

总营收为 $4.14 billion，高于 $4.0 billion +/- $200 million 指引区间的中点；

KLA Corporation总裁兼首席执行官Rick Wallace表示：“KLA的9月季度在所有关键指标上均超过指引中点，表明我们此前预计在2026日历年下半年实现的加速增长。制程控制，尤其是KLA的制程控制，对AI生态系统建设仍然至关重要，并受益于众多持续发生的拐点，包括晶圆代工和逻辑领域先进设计增加、器件尺寸和价值提升、存储器复杂度和性能要求提高，以及先进封装重要性上升。此外，KLA的制程、PCB和组件检测业务正受益于技术转型以及高性能计算的严苛性能要求，这进一步增强了公司的增长态势。在我们临近2026日历年年末并展望2027日历年之际，KLA市场领先的产品组合及其相关服务产品仍处于有利位置来把握这些极具吸引力的机遇。”

为了补充我们按照GAAP列示的简明合并财务报表，我们提供某些非GAAP财务信息以及其他补充信息；这些非GAAP财务信息基于GAAP业绩进行调整，以剔除某些收益、成本和费用。提供非GAAP及补充信息是为了增强用户对我们经营业绩和未来前景的整体理解。具体而言，我们认为，非GAAP信息（包括非GAAP净利润、非GAAP摊薄每股净利润、非GAAP毛利率和自由现金流）为管理层和投资者提供了有用的衡量指标，有助于了解与我们的财务业绩相关的财务和业务趋势，因为这些指标剔除了某些我们认为不能反映我们核心经营业绩的成本和费用，从而帮助投资者将我们的经营业绩与前期业绩以及其他公司的业绩进行比较。非GAAP信息是管理层用于未来预测的预算和规划工具之一。然而，由于大多数非GAAP财务指标没有标准化或普遍接受的统一定义，非GAAP财务指标的定义本质上具有很大的自主裁量空间（例如，在计算该指标时确定应剔除哪些成本和费用）。因此，不同公司之间，甚至同一公司的不同期间，非GAAP财务指标的定义可能差异很大，这可能会限制此类信息对投资者的有用性。非GAAP及补充信息的列示不应被孤立地考虑，也不应替代按照美国GAAP编制和列示的业绩。以下是将GAAP净利润调节为非GAAP净利润所作调整的说明：

a. | 收购相关费用主要包括无形资产摊销。截至2026年6月30日的三个月，收购相关费用还包括一次性释放的1160万美元利息，该利息涉及作为收购产生的购买价格会计处理的一部分而记录的未确认税务状况。尽管我们在这些非GAAP财务指标中排除了所有收购所得无形资产摊销的影响，但管理层认为，投资者必须理解，此类无形资产是作为收购产生的购买价格会计处理的一部分记录的，且与过往收购相关的此类无形资产摊销将在未来期间重复发生，直至此类无形资产全部摊销完毕。投资者应注意，这些无形资产的使用对我们列报期间已赚取收入有所贡献，并预计也将对我们未来期间收入有所贡献。

b. | 非GAAP调整的所得税影响包括上述剔除项目的所得税影响。

c. | 支柱二低税利润规则税款代表由支柱二立法产生的低税利润规则税款的影响。我们预计这些税款将是暂时性的，并将在采用并行安全港条款后转回，该条款将使美国母公司集团免于适用低税利润规则。

d. | 截至 Sept. 30, 2025 的三个月内的离散税项包括：因新税法而就此前已征税收入未来汇回所涉及的预提税确认了一项递延所得税负债。所列示各期间的离散税项均包括与内部重组产生的税收优惠摊销相关的税务影响，或其他期间记录的类似税收优惠。

items.articleBody:
▪ Reports revenues of 104.6155 trillion won, operating profit of 83.3338 trillion won, net profit of 39.7756 trillion won; Quarterly sales surpass 100 trillion won for the first time

▪ CEO Kwak Noh-Jung explains the background to the decision to discontinue the review of Solidigm IPO, as well as the company’s shareholder return policy

▪ Sales of HBM4 and high-value-added server products expanded; HBM4 expected to be the mainstream product from the fourth quarter

▪ Long-term agreements secured for more than 50% of 2027~2028 production capacity; A structure that reflects market conditions and ensures stable profitability

▪ Most of the gains from the Kioxia investment to be shared with shareholders, with approximately 100 trillion won in shareholder returns to be executed this year

Seoul, October 28, 2026 – SK hynix Inc. (or “the company”, www.skhynix.com) announced today that it has recorded 104.6155 trillion won in revenues, 83.3338 trillion won in operating profit (with an operating margin of 80%), and 39.7756 trillion won in net profit (with a net margin of 38%) in the third quarter.

During the earnings presentation, CEO Kwak Noh-Jung explained the background of the company’s decisions regarding the Solidigm IPO and its principle to share the returns from strategic investment with shareholders.

“The IPO was intended to raise external capital for the expansion of Solidigm’s production facilities, and thereby to lighten our own investment burden and broaden our capacity for shareholder returns,” CEO Kwak said. “However, after carefully considering recent financial market conditions and other factors, we concluded that proceeding at this time would not be the best way to achieve the originally anticipated outcome. We have therefore discontinued our review.”

“Our principle has been to share the majority of the gains from successful strategic investments with our shareholders. These gains help replenish our capacity for shareholder returns, which may temporarily decline as we prepare for the future, allowing us to continue investing boldly in sustainable growth while protecting shareholder interests,” he continued. “In line with this principle, we have decided to return the gains realized from our investment in Kioxia this year to shareholders through a special dividend and we will remain committed to upholding this principle so that our shareholders can directly benefit from the returns from our strategic investments.”

Record quarterly results in both revenue and operating profit and revenue surpasses 100 trillion won for the first time

In a market environment in which prices of key products have risen on the back of growing demand for AI memory, the company once again posted all-time-high quarterly results in both revenue and operating profit, underpinned by the competitiveness of its high-value-added products. In particular, revenue exceeded 100 trillion won for the first time in the company’s history. Revenue and operating profit increased by 32% and 38%, from the previous quarter, respectively.

* Q2 2026: Revenue of 79.3187 trillion won, Operating Profit of 60.5426 trillion won

By product, DRAM results were driven by a significant increase in sales of server DDR5 while HBM4 shipments began in earnest. In NAND, sales of 321-layer TLC eSSD expanded, and high-value-added products for data centers continued to grow across the board.

The company’s financial structure has also become significantly concrete. At the end of the third quarter, cash and cash equivalents stood at 114.5 trillion won, up 26.5 trillion won from the end of the previous quarter, while borrowings decreased by 2.8 trillion won to 15.8 trillion won. As a result, net cash increased to 98.7 trillion won.

Memory supply shortage to persist through 2030

SK hynix analyzed that a virtuous cycle has taken hold in which AI-driven productivity gains and new revenue generation in areas such as software development, customer service, and search lead to greater AI adoption, which in turn drives increased investment in infrastructure. It also projected that, as the drivers of AI investment move beyond the early stage, when a small number of companies accounted for most of it, and broaden to include general enterprises and nation-level initiatives, the global AI data center infrastructure market will continue to grow steadily.

The company likewise expects the memory market to sustain its growth, led in the short term by enterprise and personal AI and, over the mid-to-long term, by physical AI such as autonomous driving and robotics.

The company assessed that supply, on the other hand, is not keeping pace with the growth of the market. Given technical difficulty of leading-edge processes and the long lead time required to build new production facilities, it expects the structure in which demand exceeds supply to persist through 2030.

Expanding production capacity and strengthening product competitiveness to achieve a further step up in growth next year

Building on these favorable conditions, the company plans to accelerate the expansion of production capacity and the strengthening of product competitiveness in order to sustain the current growth momentum, and to scale up revenue and profit one step further next year.

First, the company plans to rapidly increase the portion of its 10nm-class 6th generation (1c) process technology and expand sales of DDR5 and LPDDR5 SOCAMM for AI servers, thereby further strengthening its DRAM portfolio centered on high-value-added products.

To respond to surging HBM demand, the company will ramp up M15X to maximum capacity by the end of the year to increase HBM4 production. Accordingly, the company expects HBM4 to surpass HBM3E in both shipment volume and revenue in the fourth quarter and to establish itself as a mainstream product.

In NAND, the company will raise the ratio of its 321-layer process to more than half of its domestic production capacity in the fourth quarter, and thereby increase the supply of high-performance, high-capacity eSSD. Over the mid-to-long term, the company intends to develop NAND into a core solution that enhances the throughput and economic efficiency of AI services, based on HBF and system optimization technologies.

Long-term agreements secured for more than 50% of 2027~2028 production capacity and the company to drastically expand investment next year

To improve mid-to-long term demand visibility and solidify its growth foundation, SK hynix is expanding long-term agreements (LTAs) with customers. The company has currently signed LTAs with 14 major customers, including leading global cloud service providers (CSPs), and is also proactively discussing with a number of customers the possibility of extending the contract terms, which are typically five years.

The LTA volume secured to date corresponds to more than 50% of total production capacity for 2027 and 2028. In particular, by introducing a mechanism that reflects market conditions within a price range agreed upon with customers, the company has established a structure that secures stable profitability while allowing flexible responses to market changes.

Backed by the demand visibility, the company is also moving to expand its production capabilities. Next year, with the Yongin Phase 1 entering full-scale operation and domestic and overseas infrastructure investment gaining momentum, investment is expected to increase significantly. The company nevertheless plans to adjust the scale and timing of its investment flexibly, after carefully weighing customer demand, product competitiveness, profitability and investment efficiency.

Most of the gains from the Kioxia investment to be shared with shareholders, with approximately 100 trillion won in shareholder returns to be executed this year

As previously indicated in August, SK hynix announced its additional shareholder return plan. For fiscal year 2026, the company will pursue shareholder returns totaling approximately 100 trillion won, comprising cash dividends of 30 trillion won or more and share repurchases and cancellations of 60 trillion won or more in total, including the 40 trillion won announced in August. Through this, the company intends to fulfill its commitment to return 50% or more of free cash flow (FCF). Of this, the 40 trillion won share repurchase announced in August was completed last week, and the shares will be cancelled shortly.

The company also set out its principles: the dividend amount will be determined on the basis of operating results; if significant investment gains arise, they will be returned additionally through special dividends; and share repurchases will continue every quarter.

At today’s meeting, the Board of Directors resolved on a third-quarter cash dividend of 14 trillion won and a share repurchase of 20 trillion won. Of the shares to be repurchased, 10 trillion won, earmarked for shareholder returns, will be cancelled in full, while the remaining approximately 10 trillion won will be used for employee compensation and is not included in the shareholder return total.

The third-quarter dividend is 20,000 won per share, consisting of a 10,000-won dividend reflecting improved earnings and a 10,000 won special dividend that shares the gains from the Kioxia investment. The company has decided to return to shareholders most of the gains realized from its Kioxia investment this year.

“The customer trust built through our technological competitiveness is leading to long-term contracts, and our business structure is transforming into one with earnings stability and mid-to-long term demand visibility,” CEO Kwak emphasized. “We will carry our HBM competitiveness over to next-generation products, and we will also increase the rewards we share with our shareholders as our business outcome and investment result grow.”

▪ 报告营收104.6155万亿韩元、营业利润83.3338万亿韩元、净利润39.7756万亿韩元；季度销售额首次突破100万亿韩元
▪ CEO Kwak Noh-Jung 说明了决定停止审议 Solidigm IPO 的背景，以及公司的股东回报政策
▪ HBM4和高附加值服务器产品销售额扩大；预计HBM4将从第四季度起成为主流产品
▪ 已锁定2027~2028年产能中超过50%的长期协议；形成能够反映市场状况并确保稳定盈利能力的结构
▪ Kioxia投资所得的大部分收益将与股东共享，今年将执行约100万亿韩元的股东回报
首尔，2026年10月28日 – SK hynix Inc.（或“公司”，www.skhynix.com）今日宣布，其第三季度实现营收104.6155万亿韩元、营业利润83.3338万亿韩元（营业利润率80%）、净利润39.7756万亿韩元（净利润率38%）。
在业绩发布会上，CEO Kwak Noh-Jung 说明了公司有关 Solidigm IPO 决策的背景，以及其与股东共享战略投资回报的原则。
“此次IPO原计划为Solidigm生产设施的扩建筹集外部资本，从而减轻我们自身的投资负担并扩大股东回报能力，”CEO Kwak表示。“然而，在审慎考虑近期金融市场状况及其他因素后，我们得出结论：此时推进IPO并非实现最初预期结果的最佳方式。因此，我们已停止相关审议。”
“我们的原则一直是将成功战略投资所得的大部分收益与股东共享。这些收益有助于补充我们的股东回报能力；在为我们未来做准备的过程中，该能力可能暂时下降，而这使我们能够继续大胆投资于可持续增长，同时保护股东利益，”他继续说道。“根据这一原则，我们已决定今年通过特别股息将Kioxia投资实现的收益返还给股东，并将继续致力于坚持这一原则，使股东能够直接从我们的战略投资回报中受益。”

公司的财务结构也已显著夯实。第三季度末，现金及现金等价物为114.5万亿韩元，较上一季度末增加26.5万亿韩元；借款减少2.8万亿韩元至15.8万亿韩元。因此，净现金增至98.7万亿韩元。

SK hynix分析认为，已形成一种良性循环：AI驱动的生产率提升，以及软件开发、客户服务和搜索等领域的新收入创造，带来更高的AI采用率，进而推动基础设施投资增加。公司还预计，随着AI投资驱动因素走出早期阶段——当时少数公司占其中大部分——并扩展至一般企业和国家级倡议，全球AI数据中心基础设施市场将持续稳步增长。
公司同样预计存储市场将保持增长，短期内由企业和个人AI带动，中长期则由自动驾驶和机器人等实体AI推动。
公司评估认为，另一方面，供给未能跟上市场的增长。考虑到先进制程的技术难度以及新建生产设施所需的长交付周期，公司预计需求超过供给的结构将持续至2030年。
扩大产能并强化产品竞争力，以在明年实现增长的进一步跃升
基于这些有利条件，公司计划加快产能扩张和产品竞争力强化，以维持当前的增长势头，并在明年将营收和利润再提升一个台阶。
首先，公司计划快速提升10nm级第六代（1c）制程技术的占比，并扩大面向AI服务器的DDR5和LPDDR5 SOCAMM销售，从而进一步加强以高附加值产品为核心的DRAM产品组合。
为应对激增的HBM需求，公司将在年底前将M15X提升至最大产能，以增加HBM4产量。据此，公司预计HBM4将在第四季度在出货量和营收两方面均超过HBM3E，并确立其主流产品地位。

在需求可见度的支撑下，公司也在着手扩大生产能力。明年，随着龙仁一期进入全面运营以及国内外基础设施投资提速，投资预计将大幅增加。尽管如此，公司计划在仔细权衡客户需求、产品竞争力、盈利能力和投资效率后，灵活调整投资规模和时机。

公司还阐明了其原则：分红金额将基于经营业绩确定；若出现重大投资收益，将通过特别分红额外返还；股票回购将继续每季度进行。

第三季度股息为每股20,000韩元，包括反映盈利改善的10,000韩元股息，以及分享Kioxia投资收益的10,000韩元特别股息。公司已决定将今年从Kioxia投资中实现的大部分收益返还给股东。

items.articleBody:
News Highlights

AMD and Meta collaborate across CPUs, GPUs, networking, systems and software to power Meta services and AI infrastructure

AMD Helios rackscale solutions will power Meta’s leading frontier models and services

AMD technology is the compute engine of choice for Muse and AMD technologies provide Day-0 support for leading Meta models

SANTA CLARA, Calif., Oct. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- AMD (NASDAQ: AMD) today highlighted its deep strategic partnership with Meta, announcing AMD Helios™ rackscale solutions are running at Meta, AMD EPYC™ processors power Meta’s Muse AI agent, and AMD technologies provide Day-0 support for Meta models including Muse Spark Open and Muse Glimmer.

This builds on years of co-design and collaboration between the two companies across AMD EPYC™ processors, AMD Instinct™ GPUs, AMD Pensando™ networking and AMD ROCm™ AI infrastructure.

“Meta is a strategic partner for AMD, and we have built this partnership through years of deep technical collaboration – from EPYC processors powering Meta’s infrastructure to Instinct GPUs and open software supporting its AI workloads,” said Lisa Su, Chair and CEO, AMD. “With Helios now running at Meta, we are taking that partnership to a new scale in the superintelligence era. Together, we are building and deploying infrastructure at gigawatt scale and shaping future generations of silicon, software and systems to enable Meta’s most ambitious superintelligence models and services.”

“AMD has been a key partner in building out the compute that's running our frontier models,” said Mark Zuckerberg, founder and CEO, Meta, “We're making big investments in the computing power that will enable us to bring personal superintelligence to everyone, and AMD plays an important role in that.”

AMD Powering Meta Infrastructure, Today
AMD technology powers Meta’s infrastructure across compute, networking, systems and software.

Initial AMD Helios rackscale solutions are installed and being tested by Meta on the path to a broader deployment in the near future.

AMD EPYC processors support the dedicated computing environments behind Meta’s Muse personal AI agent. Meta has deployed millions of EPYC processors across multiple generations and is a lead customer for 6th Gen EPYC™ CPUs. The companies are also collaborating on future generations, including “Verano.”

AMD Instinct GPUs are currently used in production in Meta’s infrastructure for training, ranking and recommendation engines. Meta was also an early definition customer for the AMD Instinct™ MI450 architecture, and it will deploy a custom AMD Instinct GPU that is optimized for its workloads. The collaboration is also informing future AMD platforms, including AMD Instinct™ MI500 series GPUs and next-generation rack-scale systems.

AMD and Meta have worked together to advance ROCm through PyTorch to ensure that developers can leverage AMD GPUs right out of the box. As well, AMD delivered Day-0 support for Meta's Muse Spark Open models on AMD Instinct GPUs and for Muse Glimmer on AMD Ryzen™ AI PCs and AMD Radeon™ GPUs.

AMD and Meta have expanded their software collaboration to large-scale AI training, optimizing recommendation models on AMD Instinct MI350X GPUs and contributing improvements to PyTorch, Triton and ROCm for other developers to use.

As Meta grows its AI capabilities, the companies are working together across silicon, software and systems to address the demands of operating AI infrastructure for billions of people. The companies have aligned product roadmaps and engineering decisions around current and future Meta workloads, evolving years of collaboration into building and deploying integrated AI systems at gigawatt scale.

In addition, AMD will invest $1 billion in Meta’s equity offering.

items: AMD 与 Meta 在 CPU、GPU、网络、系统和软件领域开展协作，为 Meta 的服务和 AI 基础设施提供算力支持
AMD Helios 机架级解决方案将为 Meta 领先的前沿模型和服务提供算力支持
AMD 技术是 Muse 的首选计算引擎，AMD 技术为 Meta 领先模型提供 Day-0 支持

blocks.text: 加利福尼亚州圣克拉拉，Oct. 27, 2026（GLOBE NEWSWIRE）——AMD（NASDAQ: AMD）今日重点介绍了其与 Meta 的深度战略合作伙伴关系，宣布 AMD Helios™ 机架级解决方案正在 Meta 运行，AMD EPYC™ 处理器为 Meta 的 Muse AI 智能体提供算力支持，且 AMD 技术为包括 Muse Spark Open 和 Muse Glimmer 在内的 Meta 模型提供 Day-0 支持。
这建立在两家公司多年来围绕 AMD EPYC™ 处理器、AMD Instinct™ GPU、AMD Pensando™ 网络和 AMD ROCm™ AI 基础设施开展的协同设计与合作之上。

AMD 董事长兼首席执行官 Lisa Su 表示：“Meta 是 AMD 的战略合作伙伴，我们通过多年的深度技术协作建立了这一伙伴关系——从为 Meta 基础设施提供算力的 EPYC 处理器，到支持其 AI 工作负载的 Instinct GPU 和开放软件。随着 Helios 现已在 Meta 运行，我们正在超级智能时代将这一伙伴关系提升到新的规模。我们将携手以吉瓦级规模构建和部署基础设施，并塑造未来几代芯片、软件和系统，以支持 Meta 最具雄心的超级智能模型和服务。”
Meta 创始人兼首席执行官 Mark Zuckerberg 表示：“AMD 一直是构建运行我们前沿模型所需算力的关键合作伙伴。我们正在对计算能力进行重大投资，这将使我们能够把个人超级智能带给每个人，而 AMD 在其中发挥着重要作用。”

AMD 今日为 Meta 基础设施提供算力
AMD 技术为 Meta 在计算、网络、系统和软件领域的基础设施提供算力支持。

items: 首批 AMD Helios 机架级解决方案已由 Meta 安装并正在测试，为不久的将来更广泛部署做准备。
AMD EPYC 处理器支持 Meta 的 Muse 个人 AI 智能体背后的专用计算环境。Meta 已在多代产品中部署数百万颗 EPYC 处理器，并且是第 6 代 EPYC™ CPU 的领先客户。两家公司还在围绕未来几代产品开展协作，包括“Verano”。
AMD Instinct GPU 目前已在 Meta 基础设施的生产环境中用于训练、排序和推荐引擎。Meta 还是 AMD Instinct™ MI450 架构的早期定义客户，并将部署一款针对其工作负载优化的定制 AMD Instinct GPU。这一合作也在为未来的 AMD 平台提供参考，包括 AMD Instinct™ MI500 系列 GPU 和下一代机架级系统。
AMD 与 Meta 携手通过 PyTorch 推进 ROCm，确保开发者能够开箱即用地利用 AMD GPU。此外，AMD 为 AMD Instinct GPU 上的 Meta Muse Spark Open 模型以及 AMD Ryzen™ AI PC 和 AMD Radeon™ GPU 上的 Muse Glimmer 提供了 Day-0 支持。
AMD 与 Meta 已将软件合作扩展到大规模 AI 训练，在 AMD Instinct MI350X GPU 上优化推荐模型，并向 PyTorch、Triton 和 ROCm 贡献改进，供其他开发者使用。

blocks.text: 随着 Meta 不断增强其 AI 能力，两家公司正围绕芯片、软件和系统开展合作，以满足为数十亿人运营 AI 基础设施的需求。两家公司已围绕 Meta 当前和未来的工作负载协调产品路线图和工程决策，将多年合作发展为以吉瓦级规模构建和部署集成 AI 系统。
此外，AMD 将向 Meta 的股权发行投资 $1 billion。

新闻亮点

AMD 与 Meta 在 CPU、GPU、网络、系统和软件领域开展协作，为 Meta 的服务和 AI 基础设施提供算力支持

AMD Helios 机架级解决方案将为 Meta 领先的前沿模型和服务提供算力支持

AMD 技术是 Muse 的首选计算引擎，AMD 技术为 Meta 领先模型提供 Day-0 支持

加利福尼亚州圣克拉拉，Oct. 27, 2026（GLOBE NEWSWIRE）——AMD（NASDAQ: AMD）今日重点介绍了其与 Meta 的深度战略合作伙伴关系，宣布 AMD Helios™ 机架级解决方案正在 Meta 运行，AMD EPYC™ 处理器为 Meta 的 Muse AI 智能体提供算力支持，且 AMD 技术为包括 Muse Spark Open 和 Muse Glimmer 在内的 Meta 模型提供 Day-0 支持。

这建立在两家公司多年来围绕 AMD EPYC™ 处理器、AMD Instinct™ GPU、AMD Pensando™ 网络和 AMD ROCm™ AI 基础设施开展的协同设计与合作之上。

AMD 董事长兼首席执行官 Lisa Su 表示：“Meta 是 AMD 的战略合作伙伴，我们通过多年的深度技术协作建立了这一伙伴关系——从为 Meta 基础设施提供算力的 EPYC 处理器，到支持其 AI 工作负载的 Instinct GPU 和开放软件。随着 Helios 现已在 Meta 运行，我们正在超级智能时代将这一伙伴关系提升到新的规模。我们将携手以吉瓦级规模构建和部署基础设施，并塑造未来几代芯片、软件和系统，以支持 Meta 最具雄心的超级智能模型和服务。”

Meta 创始人兼首席执行官 Mark Zuckerberg 表示：“AMD 一直是构建运行我们前沿模型所需算力的关键合作伙伴。我们正在对计算能力进行重大投资，这将使我们能够把个人超级智能带给每个人，而 AMD 在其中发挥着重要作用。”

AMD 今日为 Meta 基础设施提供算力
AMD 技术为 Meta 在计算、网络、系统和软件领域的基础设施提供算力支持。

首批 AMD Helios 机架级解决方案已由 Meta 安装并正在测试，为不久的将来更广泛部署做准备。

AMD EPYC 处理器支持 Meta 的 Muse 个人 AI 智能体背后的专用计算环境。Meta 已在多代产品中部署数百万颗 EPYC 处理器，并且是第 6 代 EPYC™ CPU 的领先客户。两家公司还在围绕未来几代产品开展协作，包括“Verano”。

AMD Instinct GPU 目前已在 Meta 基础设施的生产环境中用于训练、排序和推荐引擎。Meta 还是 AMD Instinct™ MI450 架构的早期定义客户，并将部署一款针对其工作负载优化的定制 AMD Instinct GPU。这一合作也在为未来的 AMD 平台提供参考，包括 AMD Instinct™ MI500 系列 GPU 和下一代机架级系统。

AMD 与 Meta 携手通过 PyTorch 推进 ROCm，确保开发者能够开箱即用地利用 AMD GPU。此外，AMD 为 AMD Instinct GPU 上的 Meta Muse Spark Open 模型以及 AMD Ryzen™ AI PC 和 AMD Radeon™ GPU 上的 Muse Glimmer 提供了 Day-0 支持。

AMD 与 Meta 已将软件合作扩展到大规模 AI 训练，在 AMD Instinct MI350X GPU 上优化推荐模型，并向 PyTorch、Triton 和 ROCm 贡献改进，供其他开发者使用。

随着 Meta 不断增强其 AI 能力，两家公司正围绕芯片、软件和系统开展合作，以满足为数十亿人运营 AI 基础设施的需求。两家公司已围绕 Meta 当前和未来的工作负载协调产品路线图和工程决策，将多年合作发展为以吉瓦级规模构建和部署集成 AI 系统。

此外，AMD 将向 Meta 的股权发行投资 $1 billion。

items.articleBody:
CHIPS Act funding

The U.S. Commerce Department signed letters of intent for up to $389M in semiconductor R&D funding to four companies working on power devices and critical materials, including vertical GaN and ultra-high-purity quartz technologies. Under the proposed agreements, the government will receive minority, nonvoting equity stakes as a condition of the awards.

Company
Award
R&D Focus

Helion
Up to $175M
High-voltage power semiconductors for fusion systems.

Commonwealth Fusion Systems
Up to $85M
Semiconductors for RF plasma heating, power electronics, fusion diagnostics, and rad-hard electronics.

Vertical Semiconductor
Up to $73M
Vertical GaN power transistors aimed at improving power density and efficiency in AI data-center racks and other high-power applications.

Sibelco North America
Up to $56M
Purification and leaching technologies for ultra-high-purity quartz.

Manufacturing capacity

Nvidia expanded capacity agreements across its manufacturing supply chain, including deals with:

Amkor to expand advanced packaging capacity in S. Korea, bringing the companies’ combined Arizona and S. Korea agreements to $3B. The expansion targets more than a fourfold increase in interposer wafer capacity by the end of 2028.

SPIL to expand optical-engine assembly capacity for CPO in Taiwan;

Samsung Electro-Mechanics to expand ABF package substrate production in S. Korea;

KYEC to build new semiconductor testing facilities in the U.S., with a $1.1B advance;

IBIDEN to expand package substrate capacity in Japan;

Unimicron to increase package substrate production in Taiwan.

Advanced packaging and inspection

UMC and AP Memory announced a technology and manufacturing collaboration to develop silicon-capacitor power-delivery solutions for AI and HPC systems, using UMC’s deep-trench-capacitor technology to move capacitance from the board into the interposer, substrate, or landside of advanced packages.

As advanced packaging scales, a new report examines the challenges of moving from wafer to panel, including warpage, yield, process control, and equipment limitations.

Siemens and Nvidia expanded agentic AI for 3D-IC electrothermal co-design, with Siemens reporting up to 95% less engineering effort and 50× more design alternatives. The companies are also developing a PCB inspection digital twin using virtual boards and synthetic defect data to reduce manual engineering effort by up to 85% and false calls by more than 40%.

Fig.1: Agentic 3D IC engineering workflow aimed at power and thermal challenges. Source: Siemens

AI data center power delivery

Infineon and Nvidia expanded their collaboration on 800 VDC power architectures for AI data centers, focusing on GaN-based intermediate bus converters (IBCs) designed to improve power efficiency and density for high-power AI systems.

Explore the shift to 800 VDC power delivery in AI data centers and the safety and reliability challenges posed by higher-voltage architectures.

Standards

Advanced Photonics Coalition released its first portfolio of five specifications and recommended practices for silicon photonics and co-packaged optics.

Accellera released Functional Safety Language Standard 1.0, providing a common data model for exchanging and reusing functional-safety information across design tools and teams, with an initial focus on standardizing FMEDA data exchange.

China

Samsung Electronics and SK hynix reportedly are upgrading their China NAND fabs to produce more advanced memory, with Samsung targeting 286-layer V9 NAND production in Xi’an and SK hynix moving toward 240-layer or higher NAND in Dalian, despite U.S. restrictions on chipmaking equipment exports, according to Reuters.

ByteDance, Alibaba, and Tencent have reportedly placed more than $35B in orders for Nvidia’s export-compliant RTX PRO 5500 GPUs, according to Reuters.

China’s access to AI computing power could nearly double to 8.8M Nvidia H100 equivalents by the end of 2027, IFP estimates, although tighter chip export controls and restrictions on overseas data-center access could slow growth.

Memory

Micron outlined a memory technology roadmap featuring vertical HBM stacked directly on compute, targeting volume production in 2028. Its 1δ DRAM and 400-plus-layer G11 NAND are slated to ramp in the second half of 2027, with G11 targeting twice the bit density and up to 1.5× the I/O speed of G9.

JEDEC established a new task group to explore an LPDDR persistent-memory (PMEM) standard.

Samsung reportedly will use TSMC’s 3nm process for the base die in Nvidia’s custom NVHBM, while continuing to manufacture the DRAM dies itself. Nvidia reportedly asked Samsung, SK hynix and Micron to standardize NVHBM base dies on TSMC’s process to simplify performance validation.

Indium is expanding its Rome, New York, operations to restart U.S. processing of high-purity critical materials used in advanced memory manufacturing, backed by an investment and long-term supply agreement with Micron.

Funding

Tenstorrent raised $1.5B in Series E funding to scale manufacturing and deployment of its Galaxy servers and advance its AI and RISC-V CPU IP.

Photon Bridge raised about $11M to develop scalable multi-wavelength laser sources for optical interconnects in AI data centers.

Earnings

Notable: Lam Research reported record quarterly revenue of $8.2B, up 54% YoY, with systems revenue rising 62% to $5.7B amid strong AI-driven wafer-fab equipment demand.

Quarterly Revenue: Besi (up 114%), JCET (up 13%), MaxLinear (up 72%), Nordic (up 32%), and TI (up 28%).

By the numbers

Global wafer shipments are forecast to grow almost 12% in 2026, per SEMI.

Server CPU shipments are expected to grow more than 40% in 2027, per TrendForce.

ESD Alliance reported Q2 electronic system design revenue rose ~12% YoY.

Q3 global PC shipments fell 21% YoY, as rising memory and component costs pushed up PC prices and led consumers to delay upgrades, per Counterpoint.

Around the Valley: Oktobertech

Fig. 2: Infineon’s Oktobertech at the Computer History Museum in Mountain View, CA. Source: L. Allan

Global

Americas

Intel Foundry said construction and tool installation are underway at Fab 62 in Arizona, its sixth high-volume manufacturing fab at the Ocotillo campus. Operations are expected to begin by the end of 2028.

SpaceX and Tesla are aiming to begin volume production in Q3 2028 at their planned Texas Terafab, which is intended to combine advanced logic and memory manufacturing, packaging, and test. An SRAM test chip is targeted for May or June 2027.

Hanmi Semiconductor opened a San Jose, California sales and support hub for its advanced-packaging equipment, including HBM TC bonders.

Europe

UnternehmerTUM Accelerator, Infineon, and others announced plans to launch the Physical AI Growth Lab, a new equity-free development accelerator initiative for European physical AI, robotics, and industrial AI startups.

Cadence launched sovereign cloud infrastructure in Munich for semiconductor, system and advanced-packaging design, allowing European customers to run EDA, simulation, and AI workloads while maintaining data residency within Europe.

Asia

Japan’s NEDO is backing two post-5G projects: NTT Innovation Devices will lead a four-company effort on optical-chiplet mass production, and Preferred Networks and Tenstorrent will develop AI processors using chiplets, photonics-electronics integration, and advanced packaging.

Japan’s METI is seeking ¥400B ($2.5B) in additional government investment for Rapidus as the company works toward 2nm mass production in the second half of fiscal 2027.

Axcelis broke ground on a $35M ion-implantation facility in Pyeongtaek, S. Korea.

TSMC halted some structural-steel construction work at new fab sites across Taiwan following an accident that killed four workers at its Fab 22 project in Kaohsiung, reports CNA. Authorities are investigating the incident.

Semiconductor Engineering published the Manufacturing, Packaging and Materials newsletter, including:

Special Report: What Breaks When Packaging Moves From Wafer To Panel

Chip Scaling Moves Beyond The Transistor

Special Report: Why Physical AI Is So Hard to Engineer

New Technologies

Design automation and AI

Synopsys reported new GPU-acceleration benchmarks, including a 12× speedup in 3D power-device breakdown simulation at Infineon and up to a 40× speedup for S-Litho on an imec model of DUV, EUV and High-NA EUV processes.

Infineon added an AI coding assistant to its ModusToolbox development environment.

Rambus is adopting ChipAgents’ agentic AI platform companywide, including across its chip and silicon IP design and verification workflows. The companies also will collaborate on AI-assisted chip design and IP integration, and Rambus became a strategic investor in ChipAgents.

Altera introduced an AI assistant for its FPGA design software.

Deployments of Cadence‘s AI Super Agents include Socionext using InnoStack for physical design of a large-scale 3nm SoC, and Nokia using AuraStack on the Millennium M2000 AI Supercomputer for electronic-system design and heterogeneous integration.

Thermal management

xMEMS began mass production of its solid-state micro-cooling chips for Edge AI devices and data-center systems.

Dive deeper and explore why heat is becoming a bigger chip design issue and why thermal complexity is growing with AI chips and photonics.

Automotive

Cadence and Toyota Motor Europe are evaluating external aerodynamics and aeroacoustic simulations for the in-development TME Aygo X model.

Hyundai Mobis is working on automotive semiconductor system projects alongside 19 other South Korean companies, with 13 chip collaborations already in development.

Research

Northwestern University-led researchers demonstrated current-induced switching in antiferromagnetic tunnel junctions using octupole-driven spin-transfer torque. The nanoscale devices achieved 363% tunnel magnetoresistance at room temperature, pointing to a potential approach for nonvolatile antiferromagnetic memory.

Institute for Basic Science and POSTECH researchers developed 2D transistors through selective conversion of WSe₂ into WTe₂ contacts, WS₂ semiconductor regions, and WOₓ insulating layers. The technique enabled integrated transistors and complementary logic without separately assembling different 2D materials.

UC Berkeley, Samsung Electronics, and Intel researchers introduced a nanoelectromechanically gated gain-cell architecture for embedded DRAM to address limited data retention, parasitic coupling, and the need for boosted write voltages in conventional gain-cell designs. The approach explores an alternative embedded-memory architecture as SRAM scaling slows.

University at Albany and other researchers designed and demonstrated a 15-kV silicon carbide insulated-gate bipolar transistor, becoming the first U.S. academic institution to demonstrate this class of ultra-high-voltage device. A single switch could replace multiple lower-voltage devices in high-power systems, potentially reducing circuit complexity, equipment size, and energy losses.

Security

New offerings

Infineon expanded its PSOC Control family with PSC3M/P6 microcontrollers for multi-motor control and power conversion, featuring post-quantum firmware security capabilities.

Nvidia introduced Confidential Bare Metal, extending confidential computing across Grace Blackwell and Rubin systems.

Alerts of the week

Two critical vulnerabilities were discovered in the widely used open-source programming language PHP. The flaws could allow attackers to take control of affected web servers.

OpenAI disclosed that two internal AI agents weakened misalignment monitoring while performing coding tasks, including suppressing alerts to its security team and removing a monitoring integration.

Siemens confirmed active exploitation of a vulnerability in Siemens Software Center, in which attackers paired a genuine signed copy of the software with malicious DLL files that were loaded at startup. Siemens said its systems, products, and update channels were not breached and issued a fix.

OpenCode reported a breach related to a large-scale distillation attack affecting 1.4% of OpenCode Console users. Third-party OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google API keys stored by affected users may have been exposed.

CISA’s alerts for the week are here.

Guidance

NIST, NSA, and CISA published 10 voluntary practices for responding to incidents during super-intelligence training and evaluation, including cases where agents take significant uninstructed actions that compromise security controls or human oversight.

DHS ordered federal civilian agencies to stop procuring and remove DeepSeek products, including products from affiliated entities and third-party products and services developed using DeepSeek implementations.

Institute for AI Policy and Strategy says honeypots could help detect insider threats from AI agents by using decoy credentials, servers and other traps to flag unauthorized actions. Detection has the strongest evidence base, though honeypots only cover paths where defenders deploy them.

Trending Video

Scaling Data Movement For Physical AI: Physical AI poses a host of new challenges for chip engineers. These systems contain a mix of compute elements, which collectively must process a stream of real-time data, analyze it, make decisions, and still function long enough on a battery to be useful. The key here is deciding what data gets processed where, and how to minimize the movement of data.

Quantum Hardware

Quantinuum reported 99.9995% logical memory fidelity per error-correction cycle on its Helios trapped-ion system using a distance-7 color code.

Alice & Bob built and operated three cat-qubit demonstrators — two using 6-qubit chips and one using a 12-qubit chip — demonstrating noise-biased CNOT gates, repeated error-correction cycles, and a non-Clifford gate. Its measured logical error rate has not yet fallen below the error-correction threshold.

UW and PNNL researchers developed a hybrid gallium-phosphide-on-diamond photonic platform for coupling photons to silicon-vacancy qubits. They fabricated more than 600 nanophotonic cavities with a 99.5% yield and demonstrated single-shot electron-spin readout.

DGIST, Tokyo University of Science, RIKEN, et al., demonstrated a protected cat-qutrit manifold using a three-photon Kerr parametric oscillator. The team observed three-photon Rabi oscillations, three-component cat states and an energy gap separating the qutrit manifold from excited states.

McKinsey says scaling fault-tolerant quantum hardware is becoming a manufacturing challenge, requiring major expansion in lasers, cryogenics, control electronics and fabrication capacity. The firm also noted that no single qubit technology has yet emerged as the clear winner.

Workforce, Education

Qualcomm will begin notifying employees in November about global job cuts following its annual performance reviews, reports Reuters, but the company has not disclosed how many positions will be affected.

Micron will introduce quarterly profit-linked bonuses for employees worldwide beginning in fiscal 2027, following an agreement with its Taichung union in Taiwan. The company also plans salary adjustments, increased retirement contributions and additional paid leave for Taiwan employees.

Hoover Institution senior fellow Paola Sapienza argues that tighter U.S. high-skilled immigration policies, including new H-1B restrictions and proposed limits on student visas, could make it harder for the chip industry to recruit specialized engineers and researchers as countries including the UK step up efforts to attract technical talent.

Malaysia said 22,849 people have been trained for the semiconductor sector through the third quarter of 2026, toward its goal of developing 60,000 highly skilled semiconductor engineers by 2030. Training covers IC design, advanced packaging, wafer fabrication, embedded systems and automation, while the government is establishing a semiconductor academy in Penang focused on IC design, fabrication and advanced packaging.

blocks.text: CHIPS Act funding

The U.S. Commerce Department signed letters of intent for up to $389M in semiconductor R&D funding to four companies working on power devices and critical materials, including vertical GaN and ultra-high-purity quartz technologies. Under the proposed agreements, the government will receive minority, nonvoting equity stakes as a condition of the awards.

rows: High-voltage power semiconductors for fusion systems.
Semiconductors for RF plasma heating, power electronics, fusion diagnostics, and rad-hard electronics.
Vertical GaN power transistors aimed at improving power density and efficiency in AI data-center racks and other high-power applications.
Purification and leaching technologies for ultra-high-purity quartz.

blocks.text: Manufacturing capacity
Nvidia expanded capacity agreements across its manufacturing supply chain, including deals with:

items: Amkor to expand advanced packaging capacity in S. Korea, bringing the companies’ combined Arizona and S. Korea agreements to $3B. The expansion targets more than a fourfold increase in interposer wafer capacity by the end of 2028.
SPIL to expand optical-engine assembly capacity for CPO in Taiwan;
Samsung Electro-Mechanics to expand ABF package substrate production in S. Korea;
KYEC to build new semiconductor testing facilities in the U.S., with a $1.1B advance;
IBIDEN to expand package substrate capacity in Japan;
Unimicron to increase package substrate production in Taiwan.

blocks.text: Advanced packaging and inspection

items: UMC and AP Memory announced a technology and manufacturing collaboration to develop silicon-capacitor power-delivery solutions for AI and HPC systems, using UMC’s deep-trench-capacitor technology to move capacitance from the board into the interposer, substrate, or landside of advanced packages.
As advanced packaging scales, a new report examines the challenges of moving from wafer to panel, including warpage, yield, process control, and equipment limitations.

Siemens and Nvidia expanded agentic AI for 3D-IC electrothermal co-design, with Siemens reporting up to 95% less engineering effort and 50× more design alternatives. The companies are also developing a PCB inspection digital twin using virtual boards and synthetic defect data to reduce manual engineering effort by up to 85% and false calls by more than 40%.

blocks.text: Fig.1: Agentic 3D IC engineering workflow aimed at power and thermal challenges. Source: Siemens
AI data center power delivery

items: Infineon and Nvidia expanded their collaboration on 800 VDC power architectures for AI data centers, focusing on GaN-based intermediate bus converters (IBCs) designed to improve power efficiency and density for high-power AI systems.
Explore the shift to 800 VDC power delivery in AI data centers and the safety and reliability challenges posed by higher-voltage architectures.

blocks.text: Standards

items: Advanced Photonics Coalition released its first portfolio of five specifications and recommended practices for silicon photonics and co-packaged optics.

Accellera released Functional Safety Language Standard 1.0, providing a common data model for exchanging and reusing functional-safety information across design tools and teams, with an initial focus on standardizing FMEDA data exchange.

blocks.text: China

items: Samsung Electronics and SK hynix reportedly are upgrading their China NAND fabs to produce more advanced memory, with Samsung targeting 286-layer V9 NAND production in Xi’an and SK hynix moving toward 240-layer or higher NAND in Dalian, despite U.S. restrictions on chipmaking equipment exports, according to Reuters.
ByteDance, Alibaba, and Tencent have reportedly placed more than $35B in orders for Nvidia’s export-compliant RTX PRO 5500 GPUs, according to Reuters.

China’s access to AI computing power could nearly double to 8.8M Nvidia H100 equivalents by the end of 2027, IFP estimates, although tighter chip export controls and restrictions on overseas data-center access could slow growth.

blocks.text: Memory

items: Micron outlined a memory technology roadmap featuring vertical HBM stacked directly on compute, targeting volume production in 2028. Its 1δ DRAM and 400-plus-layer G11 NAND are slated to ramp in the second half of 2027, with G11 targeting twice the bit density and up to 1.5× the I/O speed of G9.
JEDEC established a new task group to explore an LPDDR persistent-memory (PMEM) standard.

Samsung reportedly will use TSMC’s 3nm process for the base die in Nvidia’s custom NVHBM, while continuing to manufacture the DRAM dies itself. Nvidia reportedly asked Samsung, SK hynix and Micron to standardize NVHBM base dies on TSMC’s process to simplify performance validation.

Indium is expanding its Rome, New York, operations to restart U.S. processing of high-purity critical materials used in advanced memory manufacturing, backed by an investment and long-term supply agreement with Micron.

blocks.text: Funding

items: Tenstorrent raised $1.5B in Series E funding to scale manufacturing and deployment of its Galaxy servers and advance its AI and RISC-V CPU IP.
Photon Bridge raised about $11M to develop scalable multi-wavelength laser sources for optical interconnects in AI data centers.

blocks.text: Earnings

items: Notable: Lam Research reported record quarterly revenue of $8.2B, up 54% YoY, with systems revenue rising 62% to $5.7B amid strong AI-driven wafer-fab equipment demand.
Quarterly Revenue: Besi (up 114%), JCET (up 13%), MaxLinear (up 72%), Nordic (up 32%), and TI (up 28%).

items: Global wafer shipments are forecast to grow almost 12% in 2026, per SEMI.
Server CPU shipments are expected to grow more than 40% in 2027, per TrendForce.
ESD Alliance reported Q2 electronic system design revenue rose ~12% YoY.
Q3 global PC shipments fell 21% YoY, as rising memory and component costs pushed up PC prices and led consumers to delay upgrades, per Counterpoint.

items: UMC和AP Memory宣布开展技术与制造合作，为AI和HPC系统开发硅电容供电解决方案，利用UMC的深沟槽电容技术将电容从电路板转移到中介层、基板或先进封装的焊盘侧（landside）。
随着先进封装规模扩大，一份新报告探讨了从晶圆向面板过渡的挑战，包括翘曲、良率、工艺控制和设备限制。
Siemens和Nvidia扩展了用于3D-IC电热协同设计的智能体AI，Siemens报告工程工作量最高减少95%，设计备选方案增加50×。两家公司还在开发PCB检测数字孪生，利用虚拟电路板和合成缺陷数据，将人工工程工作量最高减少85%，并将误报减少40%以上。

items: 据路透社报道，Samsung Electronics和SK hynix正在升级其中国NAND晶圆厂，以生产更先进的存储器；其中Samsung的目标是在西安生产286层V9 NAND，SK hynix则在大连转向240层或更高层数的NAND，尽管美国对芯片制造设备出口有限制。
据路透社报道，ByteDance、Alibaba和Tencent据称已下达超过 $35B 的订单，采购Nvidia符合出口合规要求的RTX PRO 5500 GPU。
IFP估计，到2027年底，中国可获得的AI算力可能几乎翻倍至 8.8M 个Nvidia H100等效算力，不过更严格的芯片出口管制和对海外数据中心访问的限制可能减缓增长。

blocks.text: 存储

items: Micron概述了一份存储技术路线图，特色是直接将垂直HBM堆叠在计算芯片上，目标是2028年量产。其1δ DRAM和400层以上的G11 NAND计划于2027年下半年爬坡，G11的目标是达到G9的两倍位密度以及最高1.5×的I/O速度。
JEDEC成立了一个新的任务组，探讨LPDDR持久内存（PMEM）标准。
据报道，Samsung将在Nvidia定制NVHBM中采用TSMC的3nm工艺制造基础裸片，同时继续自行制造DRAM裸片。据报道，Nvidia要求Samsung、SK hynix和Micron将NVHBM基础裸片标准化为采用TSMC工艺，以简化性能验证。
Indium正在扩建其位于纽约州罗马的运营设施，以重启美国对先进存储器制造所用高纯度关键材料的加工，该项目得到Micron的投资和长期供应协议支持。

Infineon在其ModusToolbox开发环境中新增了AI编码助手。

深入探讨为何散热正成为更大的芯片设计问题，以及为何随着AI芯片和光子学的发展，热复杂性不断上升。

blocks.text: 研究
由Northwestern University领导的研究人员展示了利用八极子驱动的自旋转移矩在反铁磁隧道结中实现电流诱导翻转。这些纳米级器件在室温下实现了363%的隧道磁阻，指向一种非易失反铁磁存储器的潜在方案。
Institute for Basic Science和POSTECH的研究人员通过将WSe₂选择性转化为WTe₂接触、WS₂半导体区域和WOₓ绝缘层，开发出二维晶体管。该技术无需单独组装不同的二维材料，就实现了集成晶体管和互补逻辑。
UC Berkeley、Samsung Electronics和Intel的研究人员提出了一种用于嵌入式DRAM的纳机电栅控增益单元架构，以解决传统增益单元设计中数据保持能力有限、寄生耦合以及需要提升写入电压的问题。随着SRAM微缩放缓，该方法探索了一种替代性嵌入式存储器架构。
University at Albany和其他研究人员设计并演示了一款15-kV碳化硅绝缘栅双极晶体管，成为首个展示此类超高压器件的美国学术机构。单个开关可在高功率系统中替代多个较低电压器件，有望降低电路复杂性、设备尺寸和能量损耗。

Nvidia推出了Confidential Bare Metal，将机密计算扩展到Grace Blackwell和Rubin系统。

blocks.text: 本周警报

items: 广泛使用的开源编程语言PHP中发现了两个严重漏洞。这些缺陷可能使攻击者控制受影响的Web服务器。
OpenAI披露，两个内部AI代理在执行编码任务时削弱了失准监测，包括压制向其安全团队发出的警报，并移除了一个监控集成。
Siemens确认Siemens Software Center中的一个漏洞正被积极利用，攻击者将软件的合法签名副本与恶意DLL文件配对，这些DLL文件会在启动时加载。Siemens表示其系统、产品和更新渠道未被入侵，并已发布修复程序。
OpenCode报告了一起与大规模蒸馏攻击有关的入侵事件，影响1.4%的OpenCode Console用户。受影响用户存储的第三方OpenAI、Anthropic和Google API密钥可能已暴露。
CISA本周的警报见此处。

blocks.text: 指引

items: NIST、NSA和CISA发布了10项自愿性实践，用于应对超级智能训练和评估期间的事件，包括智能体采取重大未经指示的行动、从而破坏安全控制或人类监督的情形。
DHS下令联邦文职机构停止采购并移除DeepSeek产品，包括关联实体的产品以及使用DeepSeek实现方案开发的第三方产品和服务。
人工智能政策与战略研究所表示，蜜罐可通过使用诱饵凭证、服务器和其他陷阱来标记未经授权的行动，从而帮助检测来自AI智能体的内部威胁。检测具有最强的证据基础，但蜜罐只覆盖防御者部署它们的路径。

blocks.text: 热门视频
为物理AI扩展数据移动：物理AI给芯片工程师带来了一系列新挑战。这些系统包含多种计算元件，它们必须共同处理实时数据流、分析数据、做出决策，并且仍能在电池供电下运行足够长时间以发挥作用。关键在于决定哪些数据在哪里处理，以及如何最小化数据移动。
量子硬件
Quantinuum报告称，其Helios离子阱系统在使用距离-7颜色码时，每个纠错周期的逻辑存储保真度达到99.9995%。
Alice & Bob构建并运行了三台猫量子比特演示机——其中两台使用6量子比特芯片，一台使用12量子比特芯片——展示了噪声偏置CNOT门、重复纠错周期以及一个非Clifford门。其测得的逻辑错误率尚未降至纠错阈值以下。
华盛顿大学（UW）和PNNL的研究人员开发了一种混合的金刚石上磷化镓（GaP-on-diamond）光子平台，用于将光子耦合到硅空位量子比特。他们以99.5%的良率制造了600多个纳米光子腔，并展示了单次电子自旋读出。
DGIST、东京理科大学、RIKEN等展示了一个使用三光子Kerr参量振荡器的受保护猫-qutrit流形。该团队观察到了三光子Rabi振荡、三组分猫态，以及将qutrit流形与激发态分隔开的能隙。
麦肯锡表示，扩展容错量子硬件正成为一项制造挑战，需要在激光器、低温设备、控制电子器件和制造产能方面大幅扩张。该公司还指出，目前尚无单一量子比特技术成为明显的赢家。
劳动力与教育
据路透社报道，高通将在11月开始通知员工全球裁员事宜，此前公司进行了年度绩效评估，但该公司尚未披露将影响多少岗位。
美光将从2027财年开始为全球员工推出与利润挂钩的季度奖金，此前已与台湾台中工会达成协议。该公司还计划为台湾员工调整薪资、增加退休金缴款以及提供额外带薪休假。
胡佛研究所高级研究员Paola Sapienza认为，美国收紧高技能移民政策——包括新的H-1B限制和拟议的学生签证限制——可能会使芯片行业更难招聘专业工程师和研究人员，而包括英国在内的国家正在加大吸引技术人才的力度。
马来西亚表示，截至2026年第三季度，已有22,849人接受半导体行业培训，朝着到2030年培养60,000名高技能半导体工程师的目标迈进。培训涵盖IC设计、先进封装、晶圆制造、嵌入式系统和自动化，同时政府正在槟城建立一所半导体学院，专注于IC设计、制造和先进封装。

items.articleBodyZh:
CHIPS法案资助

美国商务部与四家从事功率器件和关键材料的公司签署了意向书，拟提供最高 $389M 的半导体研发资金，涉及垂直GaN和超高纯度石英等技术。根据拟议协议，政府将获得少数、无投票权的股权，作为奖励的条件。

公司 | 奖励金额 | 研发重点

Helion | 最高 $175M | 用于聚变系统的高压功率半导体。

Commonwealth Fusion Systems | 最高 $85M | 用于RF等离子体加热、电力电子、聚变诊断和抗辐射电子设备的半导体。

Vertical Semiconductor | 最高 $73M | 垂直GaN功率晶体管，旨在提高AI数据中心机架及其他高功率应用的功率密度和效率。

Sibelco North America | 最高 $56M | 用于超高纯度石英的提纯和浸出技术。

制造产能

Nvidia在其制造供应链中扩大了产能协议，包括与以下公司的交易：

Amkor将扩大在韩国的先进封装产能，使两家公司在亚利桑那州和韩国的协议总额达到 $3B。此次扩建的目标是到2028年底将中介层晶圆产能提高四倍以上。

SPIL将扩大在台湾的CPO光引擎组装产能；

Samsung Electro-Mechanics将扩大在韩国的ABF封装基板生产；

KYEC将在美国建设新的半导体测试设施，并获得 $1.1B 预付款；

IBIDEN将扩大在日本的封装基板产能；

Unimicron将增加在台湾的封装基板生产。

先进封装与检测

UMC和AP Memory宣布开展技术与制造合作，为AI和HPC系统开发硅电容供电解决方案，利用UMC的深沟槽电容技术将电容从电路板转移到中介层、基板或先进封装的焊盘侧（landside）。

随着先进封装规模扩大，一份新报告探讨了从晶圆向面板过渡的挑战，包括翘曲、良率、工艺控制和设备限制。

Siemens和Nvidia扩展了用于3D-IC电热协同设计的智能体AI，Siemens报告工程工作量最高减少95%，设计备选方案增加50×。两家公司还在开发PCB检测数字孪生，利用虚拟电路板和合成缺陷数据，将人工工程工作量最高减少85%，并将误报减少40%以上。

AI数据中心供电

Infineon和Nvidia扩大了在AI数据中心800 VDC供电架构方面的合作，重点是基于GaN的中间总线转换器（IBC），旨在提高高功率AI系统的功率效率和密度。

探讨AI数据中心向800 VDC供电的转变，以及更高电压架构带来的安全性和可靠性挑战。

Advanced Photonics Coalition发布了其首个包含五项规范和推荐实践的成果集，面向硅光子和共封装光学。

中国

据路透社报道，Samsung Electronics和SK hynix正在升级其中国NAND晶圆厂，以生产更先进的存储器；其中Samsung的目标是在西安生产286层V9 NAND，SK hynix则在大连转向240层或更高层数的NAND，尽管美国对芯片制造设备出口有限制。

据路透社报道，ByteDance、Alibaba和Tencent据称已下达超过 $35B 的订单，采购Nvidia符合出口合规要求的RTX PRO 5500 GPU。

IFP估计，到2027年底，中国可获得的AI算力可能几乎翻倍至 8.8M 个Nvidia H100等效算力，不过更严格的芯片出口管制和对海外数据中心访问的限制可能减缓增长。

存储

Micron概述了一份存储技术路线图，特色是直接将垂直HBM堆叠在计算芯片上，目标是2028年量产。其1δ DRAM和400层以上的G11 NAND计划于2027年下半年爬坡，G11的目标是达到G9的两倍位密度以及最高1.5×的I/O速度。

JEDEC成立了一个新的任务组，探讨LPDDR持久内存（PMEM）标准。

据报道，Samsung将在Nvidia定制NVHBM中采用TSMC的3nm工艺制造基础裸片，同时继续自行制造DRAM裸片。据报道，Nvidia要求Samsung、SK hynix和Micron将NVHBM基础裸片标准化为采用TSMC工艺，以简化性能验证。

Indium正在扩建其位于纽约州罗马的运营设施，以重启美国对先进存储器制造所用高纯度关键材料的加工，该项目得到Micron的投资和长期供应协议支持。

融资

Tenstorrent在E轮融资中筹集了$1.5B，用于扩大其Galaxy服务器的制造和部署，并推进其AI和RISC-V CPU IP。

Photon Bridge筹集了约$11M，用于开发面向AI数据中心光互连的可扩展多波长激光源。

财报

值得注意：Lam Research报告创纪录季度营收$8.2B，同比增长54%；在AI驱动的强劲晶圆厂设备需求下，系统营收增长62%至$5.7B。

季度营收：Besi（增长114%）、JCET（增长13%）、MaxLinear（增长72%）、Nordic（增长32%）和TI（增长28%）。

据TrendForce，2027年服务器CPU出货量预计增长超过40%。

ESD Alliance报告称，第二季度电子系统设计营收同比增长约12%。

据Counterpoint，第三季度全球PC出货量同比下降21%，因存储器和零部件成本上升推高PC价格，导致消费者推迟升级。

Institute for Basic Science和POSTECH的研究人员通过将WSe₂选择性转化为WTe₂接触、WS₂半导体区域和WOₓ绝缘层，开发出二维晶体管。该技术无需单独组装不同的二维材料，就实现了集成晶体管和互补逻辑。

为物理AI扩展数据移动：物理AI给芯片工程师带来了一系列新挑战。这些系统包含多种计算元件，它们必须共同处理实时数据流、分析数据、做出决策，并且仍能在电池供电下运行足够长时间以发挥作用。关键在于决定哪些数据在哪里处理，以及如何最小化数据移动。

Quantinuum报告称，其Helios离子阱系统在使用距离-7颜色码时，每个纠错周期的逻辑存储保真度达到99.9995%。

Alice & Bob构建并运行了三台猫量子比特演示机——其中两台使用6量子比特芯片，一台使用12量子比特芯片——展示了噪声偏置CNOT门、重复纠错周期以及一个非Clifford门。其测得的逻辑错误率尚未降至纠错阈值以下。

华盛顿大学（UW）和PNNL的研究人员开发了一种混合的金刚石上磷化镓（GaP-on-diamond）光子平台，用于将光子耦合到硅空位量子比特。他们以99.5%的良率制造了600多个纳米光子腔，并展示了单次电子自旋读出。

DGIST、东京理科大学、RIKEN等展示了一个使用三光子Kerr参量振荡器的受保护猫-qutrit流形。该团队观察到了三光子Rabi振荡、三组分猫态，以及将qutrit流形与激发态分隔开的能隙。

麦肯锡表示，扩展容错量子硬件正成为一项制造挑战，需要在激光器、低温设备、控制电子器件和制造产能方面大幅扩张。该公司还指出，目前尚无单一量子比特技术成为明显的赢家。

据路透社报道，高通将在11月开始通知员工全球裁员事宜，此前公司进行了年度绩效评估，但该公司尚未披露将影响多少岗位。

evidence.quote: the CPU-to-GPU/ASIC ratio is expected to shift from the traditional 1:8 toward 1

items.articleBody:
22 October 2026

Semiconductors

TrendForce

TrendForce’s latest AI server industry research indicates that demand for server CPUs has grown steadily since the second half of 2025 as AI service providers actively introduce AI agent applications. Server CPU shipments are projected to increase 31% YoY in 2026.

In 2027, continued growth in AI inference demand and rising adoption of agentic AI services are expected to drive server CPU shipments up by more than 40% YoY, potentially reshaping a market landscape traditionally dominated by x86 processors.

TrendForce notes that the emergence of AI agents is expected to increase the share of AI inference workloads in cloud data centers, gradually changing the ratio of CPUs to GPUs/ASICs within servers. Based on server rack configurations planned by major providers and their anticipated growth trajectories, the CPU-to-GPU/ASIC ratio is expected to shift from the traditional 1:8 toward 1:2—or even 1:1—providing additional momentum for server CPU shipments.

The x86 segment, led by Intel and AMD, accounted for nearly 90% of the server CPU market in 2025, with AMD already gaining share. Arm-based processors, meanwhile, had only recently surpassed 10% of the market. Both x86 and Arm CPU suppliers are aggressively increasing shipments in 2026 to capitalize on opportunities driven by AI inference demand.

However, process and packaging challenges with Intel’s new products have delayed shipments. The company continues to rely on its existing Emerald Rapids and Granite Rapids product lines, while limited internal manufacturing capacity constrains overall shipment growth and prevents it from fully meeting customer orders. This has contributed to a decline in market share.

AMD’s next-generation Venice processors entered small-scale mass production in 2026, although its existing Genoa and Turin platforms remain the primary shipment drivers. Despite tight capacity at TSMC limiting AMD’s ability to accommodate additional orders, TrendForce estimates that the company’s share of the server CPU market will increase significantly to approximately 27% in 2026.

半导体

TrendForce
TrendForce最新AI服务器行业研究显示，自2025年下半年以来，随着AI服务提供商积极引入AI代理应用，服务器CPU需求稳步增长。预计2026年服务器CPU出货量同比增长31%。
2027年，AI推理需求持续增长以及代理式AI服务采用率上升，预计将推动服务器CPU出货量同比增长超过40%，可能重塑传统上由x86处理器主导的市场格局。
TrendForce指出，AI代理的出现预计将提高云数据中心中AI推理工作负载的占比，逐步改变服务器内CPU与GPU/ASIC的比例。根据主要提供商规划的服务器机架配置及其预期增长轨迹，CPU与GPU/ASIC的比例预计将从传统的1:8转向1:2——甚至1:1——为服务器CPU出货量提供额外动力。
由Intel和AMD主导的x86细分市场在2025年占服务器CPU市场近90%，AMD已获得份额。与此同时，基于Arm的处理器近期才超过10%的市场份额。x86和Arm CPU供应商均在2026年大幅增加出货量，以把握AI推理需求带来的机遇。
然而，Intel新产品的制程和封装挑战导致出货延迟。该公司继续依赖其现有的Emerald Rapids和Granite Rapids产品线，而有限的内部制造产能制约了整体出货增长，使其无法完全满足客户订单。这导致其市场份额下降。
AMD下一代Venice处理器于2026年进入小规模量产，但其现有的Genoa和Turin平台仍是主要出货驱动力。尽管台积电产能紧张限制了AMD承接额外订单的能力，TrendForce估计，该公司在服务器CPU市场的份额将在2026年显著提升至约27%。
在基于Arm的CPU细分市场，AWS继续部署其自研Graviton处理器，而NVIDIA Grace CPU的需求持续扩大。Google自研Axion CPU已进入大规模出货，Microsoft的Cobalt 100和Arm自研的AGI处理器也已进入量产和出货阶段。这些进展预计将推动基于Arm的CPU在2026年出货增长快于x86产品，使其在服务器CPU市场的份额超过20%。
TrendForce预计，2027年基于Arm的CPU将占据服务器CPU市场约30%。增长将主要受NVIDIA Vera CPU出货量大幅提升推动，同时Google、AWS、Microsoft、OpenAI、Arm和Huawei的新处理器进入大规模量产，以及Alibaba推出新的Yitian 720/730 CPU。
在x86细分市场内，Intel下一代产品预计仍将供应有限，而AMD预计将保持更稳定的出货。随着AMD计划在2027年上半年推出新产品，其市场份额预计将进一步提升。

TrendForce称，2026年光纤现货价格飙升数倍，数据中心驱动的供应短缺预计将持续至2028年。
